overall: The AG found the Board of Assessors violated the law by omitting documents lists and roll-call votes from certain minutes and by responding late to minutes requests, but found no violation on notice specificity or member lists, and ordered minutes revised.

allegations.summary: Alleged the Board of Assessors' notices for executive sessions were not sufficiently detailed (filed 4/4/19 and 4/10/19).
allegations.key_passage: We generally consider a topic sufficiently specific when a reasonable member of the public could read the topic and understand the anticipated nature of the public body's discussion.

allegations.summary: Alleged the Board of Assessors' minutes failed to list members present and absent.
allegations.key_passage: a public body does not violate the law by listing in its minutes only the members who were present at each meeting.

allegations.summary: Alleged the Board of Assessors' minutes failed to provide a list of documents used at the meeting.
Alleged the Board of Assessors' minutes did not correctly record the procedure for entering executive session, including the roll call vote of each member.
allegations.key_passage: Minutes that simply reflect that a roll call vote was conducted before convening in executive session do not satisfy the Open Meeting Law's requirement that the vote of each member be recorded by roll call and entered in the minutes.

allegations.summary: Alleged the Board of Assessors failed to timely respond to a request for minutes of its 1/16/19, 2/6/19 and 2/13/19 meetings (filed 3/26/19).
allegations.key_passage: The minutes of an open session, if they exist and whether approved or in draft form, shall be made available upon request by any person within 10 days.

allegations.summary: Alleged the Board of Assessors failed to timely respond to a second request for minutes covering various meetings (filed 3/26/19).
allegations.key_passage: The minutes of an open session, if they exist and whether approved or in draft form, shall be made available upon request by any person within 10 days.

remedy: Revise the minutes of the January 16, 2019 and February 6, 2019 meetings so that each member's vote to convene in executive session is recorded by roll call and to include a list of the documents used during each meeting.
Revise the minutes of the March 6, 2019 meeting to include a list of the documents used during the meeting.
Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law's requirements.
Notify the Attorney General in writing of compliance with the orders within 30 days of receipt of the letter.
remedy_passage: the Board of Assessors to revise the minutes of its January 16, 2019 and February 6, 2019 meetings so that the vote of each member to convene in executive session is recorded by roll call and to include a list of the documents used during each meeting;
